problems: principality-of-vitebsk fix 1 applied: all four keyframes, nine ledger regions, the war zones and the predecessor/successor land now draw the Vitebsk fief only, the 60 km disc round Vitsyebsk intersected with Cliopatria's Polotsk 1202 core (31 of 164 cells, about 6,500 km2). This is the exact complement of the principality-of-polotsky 1101-1194 keyframe (133 cells), so Polotsk is no longer drawn twice. Cliopatria's two Vitebsk shapes are verdict wrong. The Polotsk dossier's 1101 split and 1195 gain events draw the plain 60 km disc (52 cells, 21 outside the core); the Vitebsk side is clipped to the core, and the Polotsk owner may want to clip them the same way.

principality-of-vitebsk fix 2 applied: ruler spans made contiguous (Vseslav Vasilkovich to 1162, Briachislav Vasilkovich to 1180); the page's printed years are in the notes and it says itself that its list has overlapping dates.

Thin item not applied (disagreement, see notes): Vitebsk 1195-1320. For the orchestrator: grand-duchy-of-lithuania has gain 1318 with counterpart principality-of-vitebsk, but the Vitebsk dossier ends in 1195 and the Polotsk dossier draws the Vitebsk land as its own to 1306; the Vitebsk page has no 1318 (it has 'incorporated into the Grand Duchy of Lithuania' in 1320, Algirdas from 1320). Either eu-15 re-targets the 1318 gain (counterpart principality-of-polotsky or nobody, or move to 1320), or Polotsk subtracts the Vitebsk disc from its 1195-1306 keyframes and a gap-filler adds a Vitebsk span 1307-1320.
